devdoc.details: Manages the lifecycle of AI training tasks submitted to the network.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

associateModelToTask(uint256,string).details: Associates a model CID with a specific task. Can be called internally or by other contracts. Typically called when a model is submitted to ModelRegistry referencing this task. Requires access control if called externally.

cancelTask(uint256).details: Allows the owner or publisher to cancel a pending or active task.

completeTask(uint256).details: Allows the owner or publisher to mark an active task as completed. Note: Reward distribution logic is NOT handled here.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

startTask(uint256).details: Allows the owner to activate a pending task.

submitTask(string,string,uint256,uint256.details: Allows anyone (or restrict with roles later) to submit a new task.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.
